messages.text: BL-2050 🎵 in progress — A forwarding git_handoff whose role committed for its ticket since the parcel was queued is never completed as a no-op - the coder seat finished the BL-1843 and BL-2033 bounces on 2026-10-06, rewrote the stale root HANDOFF.md, and completed both with done_with_current --no-op "... handoff written", so neither fix was ever forwarded; done_with_current refuses that --no-op for every role but QA, its refusal names the commit and the git_handoff to send, and HANDOFF.md moves to docs/deprecated/
